A1.question: She ___ from Russia.
A1.explanation: Present simple: для he/she/it — is. She is from Russia.

A1.question: ___ you have a sister?
A1.explanation: Вопрос с глаголом have для you — Do you have. Does — только для he/she/it.

A1.question: I have ___ cat and a dog.
A1.explanation: Первое упоминание предмета — неопределённый артикль. Перед согласным звуком — a.

A1.question: This is ___ orange.
A1.explanation: Перед гласным звуком — an: an orange.

A1.question: They ___ football every weekend.
A1.explanation: Present simple, they: глагол без окончания — play.

A1.question: She ___ to school by bus.
A1.explanation: he/she/it в Present simple — окончание -es после -o: goes.

A1.question: There are two ___ on the table.
A1.explanation: После числительного two — множественное число: two books.

A1.question: ___ you from England?
A1.explanation: Вопрос с глаголом to be для you — Are: Are you from England?

A1.question: They ___ at home.
A1.explanation: To be для they — are: They are at home.

A1.question: I ___ a student.
A1.explanation: To be для I — am: I am a student.

A1.question: My sister ___ like ice cream.
A1.explanation: Отрицание в Present simple для he/she/it — doesn't: My sister doesn't like ice cream.

A1.question: Look! The baby ___.
A1.explanation: Действие прямо сейчас — Present continuous: am/is/are + -ing. The baby is sleeping.

A1.question: ___ you playing football now?
A1.explanation: Вопрос в Present continuous — to be перед подлежащим: Are you playing football now?

A1.question: There are two ___ in the room.
A1.explanation: Неправильное множественное число: child → children.

A1.question: This is ___ car.
A1.explanation: Перед существительным — притяжательное прилагательное: my car.

A1.question: It is ___ umbrella.
A1.explanation: Притяжательный падеж: Ann's umbrella — зонтик Анны.

A1.question: ___ is my friend.
A1.explanation: Подлежащее — форма he: He is my friend.

A1.question: ___ are my keys.
A1.explanation: Множественное число с глаголом are — these: These are my keys.

A1.question: I ___ swim well.
A1.explanation: Модальный глагол can не меняется и стоит без to: I can swim well.

A1.question: The cat is ___ the table.
A1.explanation: На поверхности — on: on the table.

A2.question: Yesterday I ___ to the cinema.
A2.explanation: Past simple от go — неправильный глагол: went.

A2.question: She didn't ___ the question.
A2.explanation: После didn't — инфинитив без to: didn't answer.

A2.question: There isn't ___ milk in the fridge.
A2.explanation: В отрицании — any: isn't any milk.

A2.question: Would you like ___ coffee?
A2.explanation: В предложении-угощении — some: Would you like some coffee?

A2.question: She is ___ than her brother.
A2.explanation: Сравнительная степень односложных прилагательных — -er: taller.

A2.question: They are going ___ football tomorrow.
A2.explanation: Конструкция going to + инфинитив: are going to play.

A2.question: How ___ books do you have?
A2.explanation: Books — счётное существительное: how many.

A2.question: I ___ my homework last night.
A2.explanation: Действие вчера — Past simple: правильный глагол + -ed, finished.

A2.question: ___ she at school yesterday?
A2.explanation: Вопрос к to be в прошедшем для he/she/it — Was: Was she at school?

A2.question: They ___ happy last weekend.
A2.explanation: To be в прошедшем для they — were: They were happy.

A2.question: This is the ___ building in the city.
A2.explanation: Превосходная степень односложных прилагательных — the + -est: the tallest building.

A2.question: I bought ___ bread at the shop.
A2.explanation: В утвердительном предложении — some: some bread.

A2.question: We ___ see you tomorrow.
A2.explanation: Будущее время — will + инфинитив: will see.

A2.question: How ___ water do you drink a day?
A2.explanation: Water — несчётное существительное: how much.

A2.question: It's hot in here. ___ I open the window?
A2.explanation: Предложение помощи — Shall I...? Shall I open the window?

A2.question: You ___ go to bed early tonight.
A2.explanation: Совет — should + инфинитив без to: should go.

A2.question: Look at ___! They are dancing.
A2.explanation: После предлога — объектное местоимение: look at them.

A2.question: Whose bag is this? It's ___.
A2.explanation: Без существительного — притяжательное местоимение: mine.

A2.question: I always ___ at seven o'clock.
A2.explanation: Регулярное действие + наречие always — Present simple: I always get up.

A2.question: She ___ very fast.
A2.explanation: He/she/it в Present simple — окончание -s: runs.

B1.question: I have lived here ___ 2015.
B1.explanation: Точка отсчёта — since (since 2015); период — for (for five years).

B1.question: She has already ___ the report.
B1.explanation: Present perfect: have/has + третья форма глагола (finished).

B1.question: If it ___ tomorrow, we will stay home.
B1.explanation: Первый тип условия: после if — Present simple, а will — в главной части.

B1.question: I enjoy ___ to music.
B1.explanation: Enjoy + герундий: enjoy listening.

B1.question: The car was ___ by my brother.
B1.explanation: Страдательный залог: was + третья форма (repaired).

B1.question: You ___ be late for the exam.
B1.explanation: Запрет — mustn't. Don't have to — «не обязательно», не запрет.

B1.question: I used ___ coffee, but now I drink tea.
B1.explanation: Used to + инфинитив — «раньше пил»: used to drink.

B1.question: She has lived here ___ five years.
B1.explanation: Период времени — for (for five years); точка отсчёта — since (since 2015).

B1.question: I haven't finished my homework ___.
B1.explanation: В отрицании Present perfect — yet: haven't finished yet. Already — в утверждениях.

B1.question: While I was cooking, the phone ___.
B1.explanation: Фоновое действие (Past continuous) прервано коротким (Past simple): the phone rang.

B1.question: When we arrived, they ___ lunch.
B1.explanation: Действие раньше другого в прошлом — Past perfect: had eaten.

B1.question: The man ___ helped us is a teacher.
B1.explanation: Относительное местоимение для человека в роли подлежащего — who.

B1.question: I'm interested ___ learning languages.
B1.explanation: Be interested in + герундий: interested in learning.

B1.question: She stopped ___ chocolate to lose weight.
B1.explanation: Stop + герундий — «перестать»: stopped eating. Stop + инфинитив — «остановиться, чтобы».

B1.question: You don't ___ pay now.
B1.explanation: «Не обязательно» — don't have to; must не употребляется с отрицанием do.

B1.question: This box is too heavy ___ me to lift.
B1.explanation: Конструкция too... for somebody to do: too heavy for me to lift.

B1.question: It was ___ a good film that I watched it twice.
B1.explanation: Such + a + прилагательное + существительное: such a good film. So — только с прилагательным.

B1.question: He ___ come, will he?
B1.explanation: Разделительный вопрос: He won't come, will he? — утвердительный «хвостик».

B1.question: When we were kids, we ___ play in the garden.
B1.explanation: Привычное действие в прошлом — would + инфинитив: would play.

B1.question: This is the best film I ___ ever seen.
B1.explanation: Превосходная степень + Present perfect: the best film I have ever seen.

B2.question: If I ___ you, I would apologise.
B2.explanation: Второй тип условия: If I were you — сослагательное наклонение.

B2.question: She said she ___ help me.
B2.explanation: В косвенной речи will → would: she said she would help.

B2.question: The report ___ by Friday.
B2.explanation: Модальный глагол + пассив: must be + третья форма.

B2.question: He suggested ___ a break.
B2.explanation: Suggest + герундий: suggested taking.

B2.question: I'm used ___ up early.
B2.explanation: Be used to + герундий: used to getting. Used to + инфинитив — «раньше».

B2.question: The man ___ car was stolen called the police.
B2.explanation: Притяжательное относительное местоимение для людей — whose.

B2.question: Not only ___ late, he also forgot his keys.
B2.explanation: После not only — инверсия: Not only was he late.

B2.question: If she had studied, she ___ the exam.
B2.explanation: Третий тип условия: If + Past perfect → would have + третья форма.

B2.question: By 2028, they ___ in this house for ten years.
B2.explanation: Действие, завершённое к моменту в будущем, — Future perfect: will have lived.

B2.question: The bridge ___ at the moment.
B2.explanation: Страдательный залог в процессе — is/are being + третья форма: is being built.

B2.question: You should have ___ me earlier.
B2.explanation: Сожаление о прошлом — should have + третья форма: should have told.

B2.question: She avoided ___ him.
B2.explanation: Avoid + герундий: avoided seeing.

B2.question: I ___ rather stay at home than go out.
B2.explanation: Would rather + инфинитив — «предпочёл бы»: would rather stay.

B2.question: Despite ___ late, we missed nothing.
B2.explanation: Despite + герундий: despite being late.

B2.question: The film, ___ was made in 1990, is a classic.
B2.explanation: Неопределительное относительное для вещей — which: the film, which was made...

B2.question: He must ___ the train — he's not here yet.
B2.explanation: Логический вывод о прошлом — must have + третья форма: must have missed.

B2.question: I wish I ___ taller.
B2.explanation: Wish о настоящем — Past simple/сослагательное: I wish I were taller.

B2.question: She is ___ tall as her sister.
B2.explanation: Равенство — as... as: as tall as her sister.

B2.question: I look forward to ___ from you.
B2.explanation: Look forward to + герундий: look forward to hearing.

B2.question: She denied ___ the money.
B2.explanation: Deny + герундий: denied taking.

C1.question: Had I known, I ___ differently.
C1.explanation: Третий тип условия с инверсией: Had I known... would have acted.

C1.question: It's time we ___ home.
C1.explanation: It's time + Past simple (сослагательное): it's time we went.

C1.question: The problems ___ by climate change are serious.
C1.explanation: Причастный оборот в определении: problems caused by... (страдательное).

C1.question: I wish I ___ that.
C1.explanation: Сожаление о прошлом — I wish + Past perfect: hadn't said.

C1.question: ___ to finish on time, we started early.
C1.explanation: In order to — «для того чтобы»: In order to finish on time.

C1.question: He demanded that everyone ___ silent.
C1.explanation: Сослагательное наклонение после demand: that everyone be silent.

C1.question: She is said ___ a millionaire.
C1.explanation: Пассив с глаголами восприятия: is said to be — «говорят, что она».

C1.question: ___ the rain, we went out.
C1.explanation: Уступительная конструкция + существительное: in spite of the rain. Although требует предложения.

C1.question: Having ___ the exam, she relaxed.
C1.explanation: Перфектное причастие — Having + третья форма: Having passed the exam...

C1.question: He insisted on ___ a refund.
C1.explanation: Insist on + герундий: insisted on getting a refund.

C1.question: I recommend that he ___ the report.
C1.explanation: Сослагательное после recommend: that he submit (без -s).

C1.question: I can't help ___ at his jokes.
C1.explanation: Can't help + герундий — «не могу не»: can't help laughing.

C1.question: He congratulated me on ___ the race.
C1.explanation: Congratulate somebody on + герундий: congratulated me on winning.

C1.question: What ___ most is kindness.
C1.explanation: Придаточное с what согласуется в единственном числе: What matters most is...

C1.question: He acted as if he ___ the boss.
C1.explanation: Нереальное сравнение — сослагательное were: as if he were the boss.

C1.question: The idea sounds ___.
C1.explanation: Глаголы чувства (sound, look, feel) требуют прилагательное, а не наречие: sounds good.

C1.question: If he ___ more careful now, he wouldn't have had the accident.
C1.explanation: Смешанный тип условия: условие о настоящем (if + were), результат о прошлом.

C1.question: I regret ___ you that the job is gone.
C1.explanation: Regret + инфинитив — «с сожалением сообщаю»; regret + герундий — «сожалею о сделанном».

C1.question: She looks ___ her mother.
C1.explanation: «Похожа на» — look like; as — «в роли, в качестве».

C1.question: ___ by his friend, he continued the race.
C1.explanation: Страдательное причастие в начале предложения: Encouraged by his friend...

C2.question: So ___ was the noise that I couldn't sleep.
C2.explanation: Инверсия so + прилагательное + that: So loud was the noise...

C2.question: Little ___ that the plan would fail.
C2.explanation: Отрицательное наречие little требует инверсии: Little did they know.

C2.question: Were it not ___ your help, we would have lost.
C2.explanation: Were it not for — «если бы не»: Were it not for your help.

C2.question: The more you practise, ___ you get.
C2.explanation: Двойная сравнительная конструкция: the more..., the better.

C2.question: He is thought ___ abroad.
C2.explanation: Сложное дополнение с пассивом: is thought to be living.

C2.question: It was on that day ___ everything changed.
C2.explanation: Усилительная конструкция It was... that... выделяет обстоятельство.

C2.question: Under no circumstances ___ the files.
C2.explanation: Отрицательное обстоятельство в начале — инверсия: Under no circumstances should you delete.

C2.question: Should you ___ help, let me know.
C2.explanation: Инверсия первого типа условия: Should you need help — «Если вам понадобится помощь».

C2.question: Rarely ___ such talent.
C2.explanation: Наречие rarely требует инверсию: Rarely have I seen such talent.

C2.question: All I want ___ peace.
C2.explanation: Усилительная конструкция All I want — подлежащее в единственном числе: is peace.

C2.question: I resent ___ being blamed for it.
C2.explanation: Формальный стиль — притяжательное местоимение перед герундием: I resent his being blamed.

C2.question: I would rather you ___ me the truth.
C2.explanation: Would rather + придаточное — сослагательное прошедшее: rather you told me.

C2.question: The plan must ___ by now.
C2.explanation: Модальный + перфектный пассив: must have been approved.

C2.question: Such was the demand ___ tickets sold out in a day.
C2.explanation: Инверсия Such... that: Such was the demand that tickets sold out.

C2.question: On no account ___ leave early.
C2.explanation: Усиленное отрицание On no account — инверсия: On no account must you leave early.

C2.question: He went to the meeting ___ his illness.
C2.explanation: Notwithstanding — книжное «несмотря на»; however и although требуют предложения.

C2.question: The sooner we start, ___ we'll finish.
C2.explanation: Двойная сравнительная конструкция: the sooner..., the sooner...

C2.question: If only I ___ listened to your advice.
C2.explanation: If only + Past perfect — сожаление о прошлом: If only I had listened.

C2.question: Only after the meeting ___ the truth.
C2.explanation: Only после обстоятельства требует инверсию: Only after the meeting did we learn the truth.

C2.question: He is known ___ a brilliant pianist.
C2.explanation: Be known as — «известен как»; known for — «известен благодаря».
